description:
## Status

Invalid architecture. PR #123 and commit 9aa977b74 are not accepted and will not be used as-is.

The semantic defects and production witnesses were real, but retaining InputFlow as a second source-denotation authority introduced reconstruction, duplicate vocabulary and a private calculation path. The valid direct/delivered/projected/reconstructed/protocol/map/callsite/base-return laws now belong to fz-kdt.200, which derives final InputDemand directly from LoweredBody and exact peer facts.

Do not restore InputFlow types, producer/store, alias closure, lineage expansion, relation-only tests or transition telemetry from this ticket. Historical measurements may be used only as baselines and proof material.

comments.text: fz-kdt.199 landed (dd07432db) and names this ticket in return_flow_mask's doc and in type-specialization.md with all three holes. The returned axis is solved over the same forwarding cone as fz-kdt.183's dispatch axis, so it inherits that cone's edge set exactly: a DirectCall dest is ignored (deliver2.fz keys 7 -> 9 for nothing), a RECONSTRUCTED argument is not an edge (hops.fz: outer/2 stays collapsed while inner/2 and mid/2 split, so two keys both publish the join -- 2 executables for 0 precision), and a PROJECTED argument is not an edge (proto_cb.fz, the protocol-callback case). One edge-set improvement serves three axes: 183's dispatch, 199's returned, and fz-kdt.165's planned identity axis on the same walk.

title: Invalid: retained InputFlow duplicated source authority
